1\. Who enters, and how
=======================

| **Actor** | **Typical entry** | **First screen** | **Goal** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Event client (P1) | WhatsApp status or message link; Instagram bio; Google search for an occasion | Home, a service page, or a portfolio item | See similar work, then request a booking |
| Business buyer (P2) | Google search; referral email | Home or Services | Judge range and credibility, get an itemised quote |
| Design client (P3) | Social post; flyer QR code | Graphic design service page | State deadline and references, get a quote |
| Returning client | Emailed status link | Booking status page | Check a quote or the schedule, accept, or ask for a change |
| Admin (P4) | Bookmark or alert email | Sign-in, then dashboard | Reply, quote, confirm, publish |

Flyer and social links add a ?ref= value (for example ig, wa, qr). It is stored on the request as a source label only; no cookie and no identifier is created.

3.2 From consent to confirmation
--------------------------------

![diagrams/journey-b.png](data:image/png;base64,)

3.3 Step by step
----------------

| **Step** | **Screen** | **User does** | **System does** | **Failure and recovery** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Entry page (home, service or item) | Taps Request a booking | Opens /book; if the tap came from a service or package, preselects it; reads ?ref= | None |
| 2 | Frame 1: service and occasion | Chooses photography, videography or design; chooses the sub-service and occasion; optionally a package or Not sure yet | Loads services and occasions for that kind; shows package price from the database | Catalogue fails to load: show a short list from cache and the WhatsApp link |
| 3 | Frame 2: when and where (photo or video) | Picks the event date; picks a part of the day; enters venue and city; guest estimate | Fetches unavailable dates (cached 60 s); disables them and dates inside the lead time | Availability fails: allow any date after the lead time and tell the visitor it will be checked; server still validates |
| 3b | Frame 2: deadline (design) | Picks a deadline; selects deliverable formats (print, social, logo files) | Validates the deadline is after the lead time | Too-soon deadline: message points to WhatsApp for rush work |
| 4 | Frame 3: details | Describes the job; adds up to five reference links; chooses a budget band or Not sure | Counts characters; validates links; saves the draft in session storage | Over-length or invalid link: message beside the field |
| 5 | Frame 4: contact and consent | Enters name, WhatsApp or phone number, email, preferred contact method; reads and ticks the unticked consent box | Validates and normalises the phone number; shows the exact policy versions being accepted | Missing consent: the submit button explains why it cannot proceed |
| 6 | Submit | Taps Send request once | Sends with an Idempotency-Key; disables the button; shows progress | Network failure: keeps the draft, retries with the same key; after two failures shows the WhatsApp fallback |
| 7 | Server | n/a | Validates; rate limits; stores the request, a timeline event and two outbox emails in one transaction | 409 date no longer free: returns to Frame 2 with the date marked unavailable; 429: waits with a countdown |
| 8 | Confirmation page | Reads reference and next steps; may tap WhatsApp or open the status link | Shows reference, summary, what happens next and when; sends confirmation email | Email slow: page already shows everything the email says |

3.4 Field map
-------------

| **Frame** | **Field** | **Applies to** | **Required** | **Rule** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Kind | All | Yes | photography, videography or design |
| 1 | Service | All | Yes | Must be an active service of that kind |
| 1 | Occasion (or Other with a 80-character text) | Photo, video | Yes for photo and video; optional for design | Must apply to the kind |
| 1 | Package | All | No | Must belong to the chosen service |
| 2 | Event date | Photo, video | Yes | Not unavailable; at least the lead time ahead; within the maximum advance window |
| 2 | Part of day | Photo, video | Yes | Morning, afternoon, evening, all day, or Unsure; the admin sets the exact window when quoting |
| 2 | Venue and city | Photo, video | Venue optional, city yes | Up to 200 and 80 characters |
| 2 | Guest estimate | Photo, video | No | 1 to 20,000 |
| 2 | Deadline | Design | Yes | After the lead time |
| 3 | Brief | All | Yes | 10 to 4000 characters |
| 3 | Reference links | All | No | Up to five valid web addresses |
| 3 | Budget band | All | No | From the list in site settings, or Not sure |
| 4 | Full name | All | Yes | 2 to 120 characters |
| 4 | Phone (WhatsApp) | All | Yes | Ghana numbers accepted with or without the country code; stored with it |
| 4 | Email | All | Yes | Valid format; confirmation is sent here |
| 4 | Preferred contact | All | Yes | WhatsApp (default), phone or email |
| 4 | Consent | All | Yes | Unticked by default; policy versions stored with the time |

4\. Flow B: after the request
=============================

5\. Flow C: quote to confirmed booking
======================================

| **#** | **Actor** | **Action** | **Result** | **Notes** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Admin | Builds a quote: line items, deposit, validity; sets the work window for photo or video | Draft quote | Warns if the window overlaps a confirmed job (the real check comes later) |
| 2 | Admin | Sends the quote | Quoted; quote frozen; email to client | Prices cannot change after this point; a revision creates a new version |
| 3 | Client | Opens status link, reads the itemised quote and the booking policy link | n/a | Quote shows total, deposit, validity date |
| 4 | Client | Taps Accept this quote | Accepted; admin emailed; deposit instructions shown (Mobile Money number or bank details from settings) | Expired quote: clear message and a request-refresh action |
| 5 | Client | Pays the deposit outside the site and may message the receipt on WhatsApp | n/a | Phase 2 replaces this step with Paystack |
| 6 | Admin | Records the deposit (method, amount, reference, date) | Payment entry (cannot be edited) | Corrections are made by a refund entry, not by editing |
| 7 | Admin | Taps Confirm booking | Confirmed if the window is free; date becomes unavailable publicly; confirmation email; reminder scheduled | Overlap: message names the other job’s window; nothing is saved |
| 8 | Admin | After delivery, taps Mark completed | Completed | Only after the event date has passed |

5.1 Client declines, asks for changes, or goes quiet
----------------------------------------------------

6\. Status page
===============

6.1 Access
----------

The page is reached only through the private link in an email. It carries noindex, is never cached, and shows nothing about the booking if the token is wrong or missing. If a client loses the email, they message the studio; the admin can rotate the token, which sends a fresh link and invalidates the old one.

6.2 What the client sees per status
-----------------------------------

| **Internal status** | **Headline shown** | **What the client can do** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| new | Request received | Wait; message us; cancel |
| reviewing | We are preparing your quote | Message us; cancel |
| quoted | Your quote is ready | Read the quote; accept; ask for a change; cancel |
| accepted | Quote accepted: deposit needed to secure the date | See deposit instructions; message us the receipt; cancel |
| confirmed | You are booked | See date, window and venue; message us; cancel (policy applies) |
| completed | All done | See delivery notes; leave a review (Phase 2) |
| declined | We cannot take this one | See a short note and a way to ask about other dates |
| cancelled | This request was cancelled | Start a new request |
| expired | Your quote has expired | Ask for a refreshed quote |

7.5 Blocked dates
-----------------

Admin picks a date range and a private reason (holiday, personal, equipment service). The range disappears from the public picker within a minute. Removing it reopens the dates.

===========================

9\. Notification matrix
=======================

| **Event** | **Recipient** | **Template** | **When** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Request submitted | Client | booking\_received (reference, summary, status link) | Immediately |
| Request submitted | Admin | admin\_new\_request | Immediately |
| Quote sent | Client | quote\_sent (total, validity, status link) | On send |
| Quote accepted | Admin | admin\_quote\_accepted | Immediately |
| Quote accepted | Client | deposit\_instructions | Immediately |
| Booking confirmed | Client | booking\_confirmed (date, window, venue, what to prepare) | On confirm |
| 48 hours before a confirmed job | Client (and admin digest) | shoot\_reminder | Hourly job picks up due items; exactly once |
| Quote expired | Client | quote\_expired (how to ask for a refresh) | Daily job |
| Declined | Client | request\_declined | On decline |
| Cancelled by client | Admin and client | admin\_cancelled; cancellation\_received | Immediately |
| Cancelled by admin | Client | booking\_cancelled | On cancel |
| Token rotated | Client | new\_status\_link | On rotate |
| Enquiry received | Admin | admin\_new\_enquiry | Immediately |

All emails are sent from the outbox with a unique dedupe key, so a retry never sends a duplicate. Every email carries the studio’s contact details and, where it contains a link, the line: “Anyone with this link can see this booking.”

10\. Edge cases and error states
================================

| **Situation** | **Behaviour** |
| --- | --- |
| Visitor has JavaScript off or it fails | Content pages work (server-rendered). The booking form falls back to a single-page form submitted normally; the date picker degrades to a date field validated by the server. |
| Slow or dropped connection mid-submit | Draft kept; retry reuses the Idempotency-Key; at most one request is created |
| Double tap on Send | Button disables on first tap; any duplicate returns the first request’s reference |
| Date becomes unavailable while the visitor fills the form | Server returns 409; form returns to Frame 2 with the date marked unavailable and everything else preserved |
| Event date inside the lead time | Not selectable; message offers WhatsApp for urgent jobs |
| Same visitor submits two different requests | Allowed; each has its own reference and token |
| Spam or honeypot trigger | Looks like success to the sender; nothing stored; counted in logs |
| Wrong or expired token on the status page | Neutral message: link not valid; contact the studio. Nothing about the booking is revealed |
| Client accepts a quote at the moment it expires | The database decides; a loser sees “this quote has expired” with a refresh action |
| Admin confirms overlapping windows | Refused with the conflicting window shown; no partial changes |
| Admin edits a sent quote | Not possible; offered “Create revised quote”, which supersedes the old one |
| Admin tries Completed from Quoted | Button not offered; if forced through the API the database refuses |
| Email bounces or never arrives | Dashboard shows Email problem; admin contacts the client on WhatsApp and can rotate and resend the link |
| Client asks to delete their data | Handled by email under the privacy policy; admin runs the anonymise step for that booking after checking record-keeping duties |
| Portfolio item loses consent (client withdraws) | Admin unticks consent; the database forces the item to Draft; public page disappears within a minute |
| Admin loses authenticator device | Owner resets the factor after an identity check; recovery codes were issued at enrolment |
| Database outage | Public pages still load; booking shows the apology and WhatsApp link; owner alerted by the uptime check |

11\. Screen inventory
=====================

| **Route** | **Screen** | **Access** | **Empty / loading / error** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| / | Home | Public | Fallback hero image if media fails; loading is static |
| /services, /services/\[kind\] | Services hub and detail | Public | Empty packages: show Request a quote only |
| /portfolio, /portfolio/\[slug\] | Gallery and item | Public | Empty filter: “Nothing here yet” with a link to all work |
| /pricing | Packages and pricing | Public | No packages: explain pricing by quote |
| /book | Booking request (four frames) | Public | Catalogue failure: short list and WhatsApp |
| /book/confirmation/\[reference\] | Confirmation | Public, shown once after submit | Reload shows a neutral “check your email” |
| /booking/status/\[reference\]?t= | Booking status | Token holder | Invalid token: neutral message |
| /about, /testimonials, /faq, /contact | Content pages | Public | Empty testimonials: section hidden |
| /terms, /privacy, /booking-policy | Legal | Public | n/a |
| /admin/sign-in | Sign-in and second factor | Public (admin) | Locked account message |
| /admin | Dashboard | Admin | Empty: “Nothing waiting” |
| /admin/bookings, /\[id\] | Inbox and detail | Scope: bookings | Empty filters; conflict and illegal-move messages |
| /admin/calendar | Calendar and blocked dates | Scope: bookings | Month with no jobs |
| /admin/portfolio, /\[id\] | Portfolio manager | Scope: content | Upload failure with retry; publish disabled reasons |
| /admin/content | Services, packages, FAQ, testimonials | Scope: content | Empty lists with add buttons |
| /admin/enquiries | Enquiries inbox | Scope: bookings | Empty |
| /admin/settings | Settings and legal versions | Scope: settings | Validation messages |
| /admin/team | Admin users and scopes | Scope: team | Cannot remove the last owner |
